learning_objective: 🎯 We will discover how to draw natural things like trees, wind, and animals dancing to the rhythm of the earth!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Even trees dance! When the wind blows, we can draw the branches bending to one side and leaves flying away like little birds.
Peacocks dance in the rain by opening their huge, colorful feathers! We can draw big fan shapes and decorate them with bright blue and green spots.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Dancing Peacock
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a happy peacock in the rain. Make its tail a giant semi-circle and fill it with beautiful green and blue thumbprints!

quick_recap: ⭐ Nature moves and dances every single day, just like us.
⭐ We can draw invisible things like the wind by showing how it bends trees.
⭐ Animals have their own special dances that look amazing in our artwork.
